channel.title: Aroido Blog
channel.description: Product notes, release thinking, and operating decisions from Aroido.

item.title: Why Teams Should Prune Unused AI Components Before They Pollute Context
item.description: Unused skills, agents, commands, hooks, and rules are not passive clutter. They add search noise, distort AI context, and make cross-repo reuse riskier unless teams clean them deliberately.

item.title: Why Multi-Repo AI Coding Gets Messy After the Third Repository
item.description: Cursor, Claude Code, MCP, and GitLab Duo can accelerate one repo quickly. The real systems problem begins when standards, dependencies, and context have to survive across many repos.

item.title: Cursor Rules vs AGENTS.md: What Teams Should Standardize, and Where
item.description: Cursor Rules and AGENTS.md solve different parts of the same problem. Teams that use both deliberately get more durable AI coding context across repositories.

item.title: Claude Code Hooks and Slash Commands for Multi-Repo Teams
item.description: Claude Code is increasingly powerful, but multi-repo teams get the most leverage from shared hooks, project commands, and durable review gates rather than one-off prompts.

item.title: What MCP Changes for AI Coding Workflows, and What It Does Not
item.description: MCP matters because it turns tool integrations into a shared protocol. It does not solve standards, naming, approvals, or dependency visibility by itself.

item.title: Cursor Background Agents for Teams: Speed, Security, and Handoffs
item.description: Cursor Background Agents can accelerate work across repositories, but the official docs also make the tradeoffs clear: remote execution, auto-run commands, internet access, and review discipline all matter.

item.title: GitLab Duo Agent Platform for Multi-Repo Teams: Where Governance Starts
item.description: GitLab Duo Agent Platform brings agents, flows, AGENTS.md customization, MCP, and lifecycle integration closer together. For multi-repo teams, that is the start of governance, not the end of it.
